tom (AE): HorizonBank POC: intermittent 429s and TTFT spikes during load test. Demo tomorrow morning. Can we triage?

rachel (CS): Traffic is short chat prompts (~40 tokens), non-streaming. Saw 3x 429s in last 15m. Any obvious deploys?

wei (SRE): Looking at route=horizonbank-poc: ratelimit window tokens exhausted then retry bursts. Sample log:

[worker-2] enqueue_delay_ms=98 batch_size=1 exec_ms=420 http_status=429 err=\"rate_limited\" route=horizonbank-poc
[ratelimit] tenant=horizonbank burst_remaining=0 refill_seconds=60

wei (SRE): Also high kv_cache_miss for system_prompt_v1 -> longer exec_ms. Hypothesis: retries + cache misses + many size=1 batches.

juno (Infra Eng): Quick mitigations: lower batch_window_ms to 12, max_batch_size=48, enable prefix_kv_cache for common system prompts, and temp increase tenant burst_tokens. Commands:
redwoodctl routes update --route horizonbank-poc --set batch_window_ms=12 --set max_batch_size=48
redwoodctl cache enable --route horizonbank-poc --type prefix_kv --ttl=600s
redwoodctl tenants update --tenant horizonbank --set burst_tokens=4000

sam (Security): Received HorizonBank questionnaire. Short answers: SAML supported, customer KMS ok, logs/redaction available, SOC2/ISO docs ready. No POC blockers.

billing-bot: POC credit requested: 2500 USD pending finance. Alerts can be configured.

wei (SRE): After changes: 429s dropped almost immediately, kv_cache_miss_rate fell (sample). Median TTFT from 360ms -> 92ms, 95th from 820ms -> 170ms. Tail still has spikes when batch_size=1; recommend asking client to add 8-12ms client-side jitter + exponential backoff for retries. If they cannot, we can flip adaptive_small_request_path for the route.

tom (AE): I'll request jitter and confirm the $2.5k credit with finance. Thanks team. Reopen if issues during tomorrow's demo.
